name: session-read-with-a-never-minted-token-is-a-200-refusal
description: The hazard #193 names: a /session/read whose token has a minted token's SHAPE (43 URL-safe base64 chars) but was never minted -- or whose session was reaped -- answers HTTP 200 with `{ok: false, reason: session_invalidated, coordinator_epoch}`. A client that reads 2xx as success treats a lost session as a read at the pinned version. The status is pinned at 200 on purpose, so a change to a 4xx is a deliberate wire change rather than drift.
